headline: The dashboard wording is corrected, but internal staff connections no longer receive the shared sign-in check.
what_changed: The dashboard now uses the correct spelling of “business.”
Visitors without a staff sign-in are still sent to the sign-in page from the dashboard.
Internal staff connections are no longer protected by this shared sign-in check; they must each protect themselves.

risks.title: Internal staff access may be exposed
risks.explanation: This change removes the shared sign-in check from every internal staff connection. If even one of those connections lacks its own check, an unsigned-in visitor could read or change staff-only information. Confirm every internal staff connection blocks unsigned-in visitors before publishing.

questions_for_developer: Please list every internal staff connection and confirm where each one checks that the visitor has a staff sign-in before allowing access.
good_news: The visible dashboard change is a spelling correction only.
The dashboard remains behind the staff sign-in screen.
